authority: Test Lead 2026-10-10: f02 has no kit or TRAIN set; produce a separate registered public TRAIN split of time-history cases, disjoint from the 384-case test menu, sized within OWNER-CCX63-EVIDENCE-GRANT-01 (EUR 10)
role: public TRAIN for model construction; never a test, hidden or exam set
contexts: the 24 round-one contexts (cooling pair x initial 40/55 C x split 0.5/0.8 x waveform rectangular/ramp/two-pulse), as the test menu
draw: numpy default_rng(20261010) per context in the menu's context order: peak W uniform on [80, 140] rounded to 1 W; on-time uniform on [5, 20] s rounded to 0.1 s; a draw equal to a menu point (peak in {80,100,120,140} and on-time in {5,10,15,20}) is rejected and redrawn; duplicates within a context redrawn
disjointness: by construction: no (context, peak, on-time) tuple of the test menu appears in TRAIN; recorded as a count (expected 0) in the TRAIN manifest
deck: f02_deck at mesh 1, dt 1, same stack, base 20 W, burst start 20 s, 120 s horizon; the full 0.5 s time history of the die-top maximum and patch centres (observe) is the training label
image: the f02 Elmer package; the original image (sha256:8bcd864d...) is gone from the operator store, so the rebuilt image from the same locked sources is re-pinned and both test menu and TRAIN use it
cost_estimate: about 40 CPU-h on the CCX63 (2-3 CPU-min per case, #787 triage measurement)
